sr_2_5_judgment.honest_verdict_AX000: SR 2.5 is NOT reachable with this 2-sleeve blend. Two sleeves of SR ~0.62 and ~0.65 with realized returns correlation 0.709 are mathematically capped near 0.71 book SR (max 0.7073 at FLOW 50%). Proven empirical limit on PIT realized monthly returns, reported honestly per AX-000 (limit of these two streams' joint distribution, not a method-shopping failure). FLOW DOES add real value (book IR 0.79->1.12, +0.33; SR +0.09; MDD -1.7pp) as a 4th orthogonal-axis diversifier, but SR 2.5 requires (a) more low/negatively-correlated sleeves, (b) a market-beta-neutral construction (both sleeves currently beta ~1.15), or (c) reconciling the SR 1.78 figure's measurement basis.
sr_2_5_judgment.provenance_note: Task cited book SR 1.78 (->2.5). STR_1715 realized-monthly standard SR on this overlap = 0.617; the 1.78/1.6399 figures are the AR_on_M4_R05 OVERLAY walk-forward basis (book_state STR_1715_AR_on_M4_R05_overlay_PG2), NOT the production-grade realized-monthly basis used for a clean cross-sleeve blend. Mixing an overlay-walk-forward SR with a realized-monthly sleeve = measurement-coherence violation. If an overlay-basis book figure is desired, Forge must re-blend FLOW with the SAME-basis STR_1715 overlay return stream.
